title: The End of Evangelion

title_lang.zh_hk: 新世紀福音戰士劇場版：Air/真心為你

synopsis: The story is a alternate ending of the final two episodes of Neon Genesis Evangelion tv series. “Air / Love is destructive”: After the failure of the artificially induced Third Impact, SEELE launches an attack on NERV. In a critical moment, Asuka confirms the existence of her mother and herself, revives, and begins to fight back. However, a new enemy descends from the sky. “One More Final: I need you”: After Shinji boards Unit-01, what he sees is the wreckage of Asuka’s Unit-02. Surrounding Unit-01, the mass-produced Evangelion units perform a solemn ritual. What exactly is the Human Instrumentality Project?

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 本作是由 TV 版第 25 話與最終話的重新製作所構成的兩話內容。第 25 話〈Air〉：在人為的第三次衝擊失敗後，SEELE 對 NERV 發動了攻擊。在危急關頭中，明日香確認了母親和自己的存在後，復活並開始反擊。然而，新的敵人從天而降。第 26 話〈真心為你〉：真嗣登上初號機後，看到的是明日香的貳號機殘骸。量產型機體環繞著初號機，舉行了莊嚴的儀式。人類補完計畫到底是甚麼？
